title: Home practical guide and safety card: metal or non-metal
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Ecosystems (7D); atoms, elements and molecules (7H)
source: Written for science/y7 lesson 60 (Home practical guide and safety card: metal or non-metal (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 60: Metals and non-metals. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To sort materials into metals and non-metals using their properties
equipment: Objects: a spoon, a coin, a pencil, a plastic ruler, foil, a wooden block
A torch, two wires and a cell if you have a kit
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Look at each object: is it shiny?
Tap it gently: does it ring?
Try to bend it gently (no sharp items)
Test with the circuit if you have one: does it conduct?

questions.q: Big question: why are pan handles plastic or wood?
questions.a: They are insulators, so they stay cool.
